grammar.title: 过程
lines: 5 The journalist immediately set out to obtain these important facts , but he took a long time to send them. take 人做主语花时间 造句：The secretary immediately set out to verify these important facts, but she took a long time to finish it. 这位秘书立刻着手核实（verify） 这些重要的事实，但是她花了很长时间才完成。 Meanwhile , the editor was getting impatient , for the magazine would soon go to press. He sent the journalist two more faxes, but received no reply. He sent yet another fax informing the journalist that if he did not reply soon he would be fired . yet / still one more / another / bigger ... yet、still 用于加强语气 造句：The kidnapper sent yet another anonymous letter informing the old lady that if she called the police she would never see her son again. 绑匪又寄了一封匿名信，通知老太太如果她报警，她就再也看不到她儿子了。

set out 出发 出发 to start a journey, especially a long journey One afternoon she set out from the coast in a small boat and was caught in a storm . Both these ships set out from Shanghai on June 18th, 1872 on an exciting race to England. NCE3-25 Four days after setting out , while the Titanic was sailing across the icy waters of the North Atlantic... NCE3-10

set out to do sth. 开始、着手(完成任务) begin a job, task, etc with a particular aim or goal Dimitri at once set out to find the thief. NCE3-16 True eccentrics never deliberately set out to draw attention to themselves. NCE3-31

事物做主语 I went on an excursion recently, but my trip took me longer than I expected . Even if you travel in ideal weather, sea journeys take a long time . NCE3-44 It took me over half an hour to get rid of him. NCE3-28
人做主语 He took a long time to send them. I took just ten minutes to solve that problem. He always takes so long to eat his breakfast.
meanwhile adv.与此同时(仅1个词性) Meanwhile , my tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been.
at the same time 同时 At the same time she felt a prick on her neck. 同时她感到脖子上一阵刺痛。
(in the) meantime adv. 同时，在此期间 n. 其时，其间 I continued working. Meantime , he went out shopping. In the meantime , the lorrydriver had to sweep up hundreds of broken bottles. NCE3-33
one more ... = another ... two more ... = another two ...
Here is another photograph of the village . There's room for one more at the table. 这张桌子还有一个人的位置。 In another two weeks it'll be finished. In two more weeks it'll be finished.
He sent yet another fax informing the journalist that if he did not reply soon he would be fired.
主+谓+宾 后置定语 （非谓语动词） 宾语从句 (包含条件状语从句) 条件状语主句
宾语从句
This led to yet another angry argument. NCE3-33
yet / still one more example 再举个例
He's given us yet / still more work to do. 他又给了我们多得多的工作做
Inflation had risen to a yet / still higher level. (加强比较级)通货膨胀已上升到更高的水平。
inform sb. of sth. They would inform him of any progress they had made. 他们将把自己所取得的任何进展都告诉他。
inform sb. that + 从句 Teachers inform me that Todd's behaviour has improved no end. 老师们告诉我托德的行为改善了许多。

sentences.title: 结果
lines: 5 When the journalist again failed to reply, the editor reluctantly published the article as it had originally been written. Not only had the poor man been arrested , but he had been sent to prison as well . 部分倒装 § 只把助动词，be动词（之前没有其他助动词）或情态动词置于主语之前。 一、原句的否定提前 否定词位于句首 二、Only + 状语 位于句首 三、 等表示程度、频率的词 (位于句首 such, so, well, often, many a time等) 造句： Not only did several people complain of 'cat-like noises' at night, but a businessman on a fishing trip saw the puma up a tree as well . 不但有几个人抱怨说在夜里听见了“像猫一样的噪音”，而且一位钓鱼途中的商人还看见那只美洲狮在树上。 However, he had at last been allowed to send a fax in which he informed the editor that he had been arrested while counting the 1,084 steps leading to the fifteen-foot wall which surrounded the president's palace . 状语从句的省略 状语从句中如果满足以下两个条件，则可同时省略状语从句的主语和其后的be动词。 每日习语 One rotten apple spoils the whole barrel. 一个坏苹果会毁掉整桶苹果。
When the journalist again failed to reply, the editor reluctantly published the article as it had originally been written .
一般过去时 一般过去时 方式状语从句 （过去完成时被动）
时间状语从句 时间状语主句
When we again failed to get visas, we reluctantly went on a domestic journey as it had originally been planned .
not only ... but also ... 不但...而且也... This hobby educates one not only in the chosen subject, but also in general matters which have some bearing on it. NCE3-59
not only ... but ... 不仅...而且... At that time, however, she was not only the largest ship that had ever been built, but was regarded as unsinkable, for she had sixteen water-tight compartments.
not only ... but ... as well 不但...而且也... I not only spoke English very carefully, but very clearly as well .
（如：notonly,not until, neither, nor, never, hardly, barely, scarcely, few, little, rarely, seldom, under no circumstances, in no way, ...)
Nor is the city without its moments of beauty. NCE3-41
Neither was I surprised when the train stopped at Widley, a tiny station a few miles along the line. NCE3-41
Never have I seen such a good movie. 我从来没有看过这么好的电影。
Not until yesterday did little John change his mind. 直到昨天小约翰才改变主意。
Under no circumstances should you lend Paul any money. 在任何情况下你都不应该借钱给保罗。
Only then did he realize that he was mistaken. 直到那时他才意识到自己错了。
Only by working hard can we succeed in doing anything. 只有努力工作，我们才能成功做任何事情。
Only after a baby seal is pushed into the sea by its mother will it learn how to swim. 只有当小海豹被它的妈妈推进海里后，它才会学会游泳(only + 时间状语从句)
Only when he saw that the man was actually telephoning the police did he realize that they had all been the victims of a hoax. NCE3-40
Such is human nature, that a great many people are often willing to sacrifice higher pay for the privilege of becoming white-collar workers .
So great is our passion for doing things for ourselves, that we are becoming increasingly less dependent on specialized labour. NCE3-46
Well did I know him and well did he know me. 我很了解他，他也很了解我。
often did it snow there. 那里经常下雪。
Many a time has he given me good advice. 他多次给我提出好建议。

However, he had at last been allowed to send a fax in which he informed the editor that he had been arrested while counting the 1,084 steps leading to the fifteen-foot wall which surrounded the president's palace.
主句 引导定语从句 informed 的宾语从句 while 引导原因状语从句 后置定语 定语从句 （修饰 wall）
定语从句 （修饰 a fax）
状语从句的主语与主句主语一致。
状语从句的谓语包含be动词。
Metals expand when they are heated and contract when they are cooled. → Metals expand when heated and contract when cooled.
Francis Preston Blair Jr., although he was born in Kentucky, lived and practiced in Missouri. → Francis Preston Blair Jr., although born in Kentucky, lived and practiced in Missouri.
he had been arrested while he had been counting the 1,084 steps... → he had been arrested while counting the 1,084 steps..
